newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: UOB launches new unit trust.
newsitem.headline: UOB launches new unit trust.

text.p: The United Overseas Bank Group (UOB) said on Friday it was launching a new unit trust to invest in foreign companies listed in Singapore.
UOB said units of the open-ended United Foreign Equity Fund would be available for subscription to the public at an initial price of Singapore $1.00 each for a one-month period from December 16.
Thereafter, they will be offered based on daily market valuation.
Minimium subscription is S$5,000 cash and subsequent purchases can be made in multiples of S$1,000.
The unit trust will be managed by UOB Asset Management Ltd, a subsidiary of the UOB group.
